hook_text: 7 245 litres of water shared among 15 tanks. No long division allowed. Can you still do it?
clip_script: A soccer academy in eMalahleni: 7 245 litres, 15 tanks. Take away big chunks! 15 times 400 is 6 000. Left: 1 245. 15 times 80 is 1 200. Left: 45. 15 times 3 is 45. Left: nothing! Add the chunks: 400, 80, 3. That is 483 litres per tank. Or split the number: 3 648 cans in bags of 12 is 3 600 and 48. 300 plus 4 is 304 bags. Then check! Multiply back: 483 times 15 is 7 245. Chunk it, then check it.
visual_style: A big water tank emptying in chunks into 15 smaller tanks, with the chunk counts stacking up beside it.
mood: Clever and calm, like a smart shortcut.
pacing: Big chunk, medium chunk, small chunk, then a quick add-up and a multiply-back check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and divide 9 636 by 12 by splitting it up.
